{{Velious Era}}{{Disambiguation}}
:Bread shipment quests are completed by handing a '''[[Bag of Bread Loaves]]''' to various Innkeepers and Merchants listed below. The original source of this quest was part of a time-locked event involving handing 2 gold to [[The Bread Shipment|Jarlen Meadowgreen]] in [[South Karana]] to get the Bread Loaves. This means that on the Blue and Green Servers, this Jarlen  NPC is no longer available. <br>
The only other source of acquiring the [[Bag of Bread Loaves]] is as an uncommon drop in [[Runnyeye Citadel]] from Sporali and Pickclaw goblins.

: The rewards are experience, faction, and small amounts of coin.

* [[The Bread Shipment (Qeynos)]], [[Karn Tassen]]
* [[The Bread Shipment (Neriak)]], [[Sal Drana]]
* [[The Bread Shipment (Feerrott)]] (Oggok), [[Innkeep Morpa]]
* [[The Bread Shipment (N Karana)]], [[Innkeep James]]
* [[The Bread Shipment (W Karana Rislarn)]], [[The Bread Shipment (W Karana Danin)]] [[Innkeep Rislarn]] and [[Innkeep Danin]]
* [[The Bread Shipment (Halas)]], [[Hetie McDonald]]
* [[The Bread Shipment (Kaladim)]], [[Gretta Mottle]]
* [[The Bread Shipment (Kelethin)]][https://www.graffe.com/forums/showthread.php?4774-Got-lv-20-Wanna-make-lv-29-and-not-kill-a-thing], [[Innkeep Wuleran]]
* [[The Bread Shipment (Erudin)]], [[Beth Breadmaker]]
* [[The Bread Shipment (East Freeport)]], Freeport Inn, [[Innkeep Nasumi]]
